title: Preview & share Artifacts

body.text: For HTML or React Artifacts, Claude provides a Preview button so you can see the real result in a preview window. You can also
share an Artifact with others via a share link
— the recipient can open it without a Claude.ai account. This is very useful for quickly sharing a
prototype or report with your team or clients

example: "Build an interactive dashboard showing monthly sales data with charts, and show me a preview."

title: Export and use Artifacts

body.text: as files directly — code as .html or .py, or a document as .md. Artifacts made with Claude are a
good starting point for real work
, not always the final result. A good approach is to take the Artifact from Claude and refine it further in your editor or IDE to get exactly what you need.

example: "For the HTML Artifact you built, export it as files ready to deploy on Netlify, and explain the deployment steps."

question: What is the Preview button in Claude Artifacts for?

options.text: Seeing the real result of HTML or React Artifacts in a preview window
Showing a preview for sharing on social media

question: Does the recipient of an Artifact share link need a Claude.ai account?

options.text: They need a Claude.ai Pro account only

question: What's the best way to use a Code Artifact from Claude?

options.text: Deploy it to production immediately without edits
Use it as a starting point and refine it in your IDE as needed
Leave it in Claude only, never export

question: You finished a piece in an Artifact and want to show a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Send your account password to your friend
